places.name: Flag Fort (Tayybah)
places.description: A small fort-style building in Tayybah village, built in 2014, with seven UAE flags on top for the seven emirates. Free to visit; a short photo stop on the way through the Fujairah mountains.

places.name: UAQ Ghost Village
places.description: An old quarter of Umm Al Quwain where abandoned houses stand next to homes people still live in. Park nearby and walk around for photos; take care inside the ruins and respect the residents' privacy.

places.name: Sharia Rest Area (Hatta)
places.area: Next to Hatta Heritage Village, Hatta
places.description: A shady spot under palm trees with small date farms, a traditional falaj water channel and covered huts for sitting. It's next to Hatta Heritage Village, below Al Hajarain restaurant.

places.name: Al Sharia Rest Area (Masfut)
places.description: A rest area with two ponds and a falaj water channel, shaded by trees. You can walk down to it from Al Boma Tower and walk on to Al Waraa lake along a path.

places.name: Al Boma Tower (Masfut)
places.description: A historical watchtower on a rocky hill in Masfut, reached by a short climb up stairs, with a viewpoint and rest area over the village. Its name means 'owl', after the guards who made owl calls to warn of danger.

places.name: Muzaira'a Dam
places.description: One of several dams around Masfut, with a lake against a mountain backdrop. Best after the winter rains when it fills up; there are no facilities.

places.name: Al Waraa Lake (Masfut)
places.description: A small artificial lake with trees next to the Al Sharia rest area in Masfut. You can walk down to it from Al Boma Tower; there's a rest area by the water.

places.name: Buraq Dam
places.description: A dam in the mountain foothills; when it holds water, the trees standing in the lake make a striking photo. It's often dry, so go after the winter rains.

places.name: Kalba Dam
places.description: A dam lake in the hills outside Kalba with ducks on the water, a quiet stopover. The Kalba Al Ghail hiking trail starts here.
